title: Triple Quantum Schubert Calculus
summary: We prove a triple quantum Pieri formula: the product of a quantum double Schubert polynomial $\widetilde{\mathfrak{S}}_u(x;y)$ by a quantum factorial elementary polynomial $\widetilde{E}_{p,k}(x;z)$ in a second set of variables $z$ is a sum over chains in the quantum Bruhat graph, indexed by a quantum analogue of Sottile's relation, whose coefficients are monomials in the quantum parameters times polynomials in the differences $y_i-z_j$ with nonnegative integer coefficients, and which is Graham-positive at $z=y$.
